continuous40.comparison_note: Matched bounded continuous40 policy. Combined-worker d8f64ccc regressed approximately5% in complete publication despite halving broker execution. Retained without substituting microbenchmark savings. A subsequent ready-geometry path avoiding a second success-path encoder process is not yet measured.

interpretation.end_to_end: Candidate d8 did not improve end-to-end completion. Both independent Windows QPC and WSL monotonic measured about5% slower in this single matched200-model run.
interpretation.acceptance_and_tail: Most observed difference is already present when the last source is accepted; subsequent drain duration is nearly unchanged. Acceptance timing includes upstream pacing and downstream completion credits, so this does not isolate upload speed.
interpretation.retry: Candidate has3 versus1 pre-admission rejections, adding2 seconds to accumulated recorded backoff; waits remain included. This does not causally account for the full22.76-second end-to-end difference; overlapping work and scheduling require caution.
interpretation.gpu: Owner execution fell13.94 to7.06 seconds and render-stage accumulated time fell98.87 to57.69 seconds. These counters do not support blaming GPU rasterization for the end-to-end regression.
interpretation.unisolated: Load, measurements and native admission/supervision became somewhat slower. Logs do not separately measure source preparation, process startup, geometry preparation, encoder CPU time and scheduler critical path sufficiently to assign the remaining difference.
interpretation.pacing: Both arms used byte-identical executed harnesses with1-second continuous polling, same4 pending ingestion jobs and40 unfinished outputs. The final5-second fallback loop did not sleep: each report has exactly one final snapshot after200 outputs terminal. No durations were subtracted.
interpretation.statistical_limit: One matched run per image; no confidence interval or claim of deterministic5%regression. Repeating CPU or baseline was not authorized.

continuous40.final_validation_scope: At operator request, final GPU validation processed all 1000 cached sources instead of another 200-source candidate arm. See compute-final-gpu-1000.json: 973 ready outputs, identical 27 invalid sources, no new failure or R2 request. Historical GPU timing policy differs; no throughput improvement established. No CPU or reference arm repeated.
